# Refine README 'F1 vs Toyota' Phrasing

Update the "Why Choose Neo.mjs?" introduction in `README.md` to use more empathetic and validating language.

**Current:** "Stop building F1 cars with Toyota parts."
**New:** "You're building F1 apps with Toyota parts."

**Goal:** Shift the tone from a command to an insight, validating the developer's struggle with general-purpose tools for high-performance needs.
